data.name: Holiday Inn Express Merida by IHG
data.address: Ave. 20 A Predio, Calle 3C Y 5A 300 A, Supermanzana Por, 97204 Mérida, Yuc., Mexico
data.description:
Set across the street from the Centro de Convenciones Yucatán Siglo XXI convention center, this casual hotel is a 10-minute walk from Plaza Galerias shopping center and 15 km from Manuel Crescencio Rejón International Airport.
The modern, streamlined rooms and suites come with free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs and coffeemakers, along with sitting areas and desks. Room service is available.
Freebies include a breakfast buffet and parking. There's an outdoor pool and a gym, along with a business center and meeting space.
